title: Russia Launches 164 Drones and Three Missiles; 137 Drones Downed
detail: Overnight Nov 7-8 Russia launched 164 drones, 112 of them jet-powered, plus three Kh-59/69 missiles. Air defence downed or jammed 137 drones, including 88 jet-powered; hits at 23 locations. Preliminary Air Force figures.
